scenario: Two-player Lucky Coin and five Ruins start; same kingdom and landscapes as original strategy search.
rules: Strict Change rules. No legacy opt-in in these new experiments.
limitations: Fixed continuation policies after one forced choice; hidden-state model is information-limited but approximate.
Focused schedule changes compute allocation and increases available search slots; this is not a controlled isolation of schedule effects.
Audit alternative proposals are not live adopted changes; live changes require separate independent verification.
Screening and validation have separate seeds; small whole-game samples cannot establish optimality.

screening.scoring: First policy win share; ties half; paired 95% intervals treat each seat-swapped seed as one observation.

adopted_trash_confirmation.selection: Every adopted trash change in the supplied benchmark; no filtering by verification effect size
adopted_trash_confirmation.adjustment: Bonferroni over all adopted trash changes in this benchmark

validation.scoring: First policy win share; ties half; paired 95% intervals treat each seat-swapped seed as one observation.
validation.multiplicity: Pointwise paired normal 95% intervals for each matchup; additionally Bonferroni-adjusted paired intervals over the two prespecified mirror tests.

compute_count_note: Recorded continuations exclude diagnostic game reproductions and failed or repeated commands.
